marks.gloss_en: kicha/kicha from the field of Ephron: as Ephron's field was 'taken' with money, a woman's betrothal-'taking' is with money
'taking' (ki yikach ish isha) means taking with money, learned from 'natati kesef hasadeh kach mimeni' at the field of Ephron
a woman is acquired (betrothed) with money
'taking' is called 'acquisition', as the field Abraham took is described as 'the field which Abraham acquired'
